pages.title: Craft
pages.text: A crafting table item denotes the "craft" action.$(br2)The recipe is determined by the crafting table's item influences. They must be in the same orientation as they would be on a crafting grid, where "down" is in the direction of the crafting table.
A mob performing this action will look for a crafting table with adjacent inventories containing all the necessary crafting ingredients. It will go to the crafting table and craft the item.
